descriptionMarkdown:
Made for grid 100*100.
It produces all Vulcanus science, at rate 50 per sec from RAW.
It produces rockets parts, enough for it self, it needs a few bots to transfer rockets parts.
Inputs are 1 belt of coal, 1 belt of Tug, 1 belt of calcit, 10k Lava, 1k sulfur.

I made it very fast in spaghetti way, but it does it purpose. I needed All science in city block, it is very easy to expand and we have stone.
